name: mcp-boundary
description: Build, inspect, migrate, and verify MCP systems at the protocol, transport, runtime, and host boundary.

interface.shortDescription: MCP engineering at the real boundary
interface.longDescription: A pure-skill engineering plugin for building, inspecting, migrating, debugging, and verifying MCP systems without confusing source inspection, local runtime evidence, transport behavior, named-host admission, or owner acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $mcp-boundary to inspect this MCP implementation against its actual protocol, transport, and runtime.
Use $mcp-boundary to build this MCP capability and verify the complete behavior.
Use $mcp-boundary to migrate this MCP implementation and prove compatibility and deliberate retirement.
